name: three_secrets
summary: Hayden Hillier-Smith explores the philosophy of YouTube editing, arguing against hyper-retention formulas in favor of emotional storytelling. The editing balances dynamic mixed-media B-roll, custom motion graphics, and deliberate pauses.

captions.notes: Select spoken phrases appear centrally as bold impact titles, along with standard bottom-third dialogue captions during guest clips.

headline.notes: Large bold text flashes across the frame to establish primary motifs, chapter headings, or theoretical concepts.

callouts.notes: Timeline overlays, video editing UI callouts, and minimal line animations accentuating key editing mechanics.

transitions.notes: Dynamic hard cuts accented by whooshes, precise match cuts between character portraits, and snap zooms on punchlines.

rules: Cut to B-roll or UI mockups every 2 to 4 seconds during fast conceptual explanations.
Allow key emotional moments and speaker reactions to breathe with silent pauses.
Use scale punch-ins on the A-roll speaker to emphasize thesis statements.
Use match cuts on character eyes across footage to illustrate continuity concepts.
Accompany visual timeline demonstrations with sound design like clicks and swooshes.
Isolate high-impact keywords in large bold sans-serif text across the center frame.
Contrast hyper-paced editing sequences with stripped-back, quiet scenes to reset viewer fatigue.
Punch in on the A-roll speaker every 3 to 6 seconds to emphasize key points.
Cut to supporting B-roll or NLE timeline screengrabs whenever explaining editing concepts.
Use match cuts on subject eyelines during rapid montage demonstrations.
Preserve emotional silence and natural pauses; do not over-trim dialog breath gaps.
Sync montage pacing and impacts to music accents and beats.
avoid: Over-editing emotional beats with continuous frantic cuts.
Unnecessary 3D VFX when a simple match cut delivers better narrative weight.
Monotonous unvaried pacing without room for silence.
Generic stock footage that does not directly advance the argument.
Full-sentence karaoke text running through the entire video.
Over-tight jump cuts that eliminate natural conversational pauses.
Unnecessary complex 3D VFX when simple juxtaposition tells the story better.
